item.title: DHS Nominee Markwayne Mullin Surges In Popularity After Vowing To Deport Liberal White Ladies
item.description: U.S. — As the Trump cabinet experienced a significant changing of the guard, new Department of Homeland Security nominee Markwayne Mullin surged in popularity among the American people after vowing to deport liberal white ladies.

item.title: U.S. Embassy In Minneapolis Evacuated Over Safety Concerns For American Citizens
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS, MN — The United States State Department issued an evacuation order for the U.S. embassy located in downtown Minneapolis on Friday, citing concerns over the safety of American citizens in the area.

item.title: Megyn Kelly Goes Back To Normal After Eating A Snickers
item.description: NEW YORK, NY — After months of mounting concern over her apparent change in viewpoints on geopolitical matters, popular commentator and podcaster Megyn Kelly reportedly went back to normal after eating a Snickers.
